type: Static UI motion storyboard; not a rendered animation or production acceptance
purpose: Help Sui engineers assess and retain reviewed resolutions, then reuse them for compatible failures.

case.provenance: Recorded approved case; static composition target, not live integration
case.diagnosis: Duplicate cancellation of an already-cancelled DeepBook order. Tatum confirms an earlier successful cancellation of the identical sender/package/pool/balance manager/asset types/order ID.
case.procedure: Reconcile the order against authenticated prior successful cancellation effects for the exact cancellation identity. If an earlier identical cancellation succeeded, mark the local order as already cancelled and stop retrying. Otherwise investigate. Independent reference integration replay proves this procedure on two genuine failures; original operator deployment is unknown and no onchain repair is claimed.

transitions.name: Enter the workspace
transitions.trigger: User activates the workspace link; destination route renders.
transitions.meaning: The engineer is moving into a task, not watching a launch sequence.
transitions.pacing: 0ms bespoke transition. Use ordinary navigation; landing content is visible at first paint.
transitions.interaction: Normal route focus/heading behavior; no scroll interception or entrance stagger.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: An entrance animation can delay the primary task or hide content when JavaScript fails.

transitions.name: Inspect a new digest
transitions.trigger: Validated nonempty digest starts the transaction request.
transitions.meaning: The old result no longer applies to the new query.
transitions.pacing: Clear prior query result immediately before request. Status appears at once; optional opacity 120ms on status only. No minimum spinner time.
transitions.interaction: Retain focus on invoked control. Mark result region busy and announce Reading transaction once. Keep any completed receipt separate and stable.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Fading old evidence out over the new request could misattribute a reviewed result.

transitions.name: Reveal chain evidence
transitions.trigger: The transaction response establishes failed outcome and memory is configured.
transitions.meaning: Chain evidence is known; reviewed memory is still being sought.
transitions.pacing: Show chain evidence immediately. Optional status opacity 120ms; no staging of digest or error lines.
transitions.interaction: Keep focus. Announce Reading complete. Checking reviewed memory once; busy applies to recall region only.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: A single combined success reveal could imply that a failed transaction was repaired.
transitions.implementation_source: inspect(): setTx(observed); failed + walrusConfigured; setPhase(recalling); loadRecall()

transitions.name: Reveal the reviewed precedent
transitions.trigger: Recall response contains a candidate accepted by the existing compatibility checks.
transitions.meaning: A prior reviewed procedure is now available for human assessment.
transitions.pacing: One result-region opacity/translateY(4px→0) reveal, 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). No stagger, glow, confetti or numeric counter. Entire text/proof enters together; no delayed blob.
transitions.interaction: Announce Reviewed resolution available once. Keep focus on the initiating control; no autofocus or automatic scroll. All essential information stays outside disclosure.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Animating a link between cases may assert a stronger causal relation than compatibility supports.

transitions.name: Show honest alternatives
transitions.end: success / unknown / no-match / unavailable / unconfigured / lookup-error
transitions.trigger: Actual outcome, configuration check or request failure selects its own branch.
transitions.meaning: No recommendation is sometimes the correct product outcome. Observation-only records and simulation runbooks remain labelled supporting evidence; they never animate into reviewed resolutions.
transitions.pacing: Status replaces in place at 0ms; optional 120ms opacity for new status text only. No shake or red full-screen flash.
transitions.interaction: One concise polite result announcement; input validation is separate. Retry only the relevant read. Preserve accessible transaction evidence and any completed receipt.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: No-match must not be substituted for an outage; unknown is not a failed transaction.
transitions.implementation_source: inspect() outcome/config branches and catch; loadRecall() recallDegraded/catch

transitions.name: Inspect supporting provenance
transitions.end: eligible with secondary details open / closed
transitions.meaning: The engineer chooses deeper evidence; the essential decision remains available.
transitions.pacing: Native open/close, 0ms height animation. No animated accordion.
transitions.interaction: Keep focus on summary and native expanded semantics. Never hide procedure/reasons/reviewer/full blob.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Animating height shifts the decision out of the reading position and can clip identifiers.
transitions.implementation_source: Phase17 native-details contract; existing provenance text

transitions.name: Open and correct human review
transitions.trigger: User opens editor; invalid submit or proof-method change produces applicable form fields.
transitions.meaning: The human supplies and approves a specific evidenced resolution.
transitions.pacing: Editor appears at 0ms, no sliding drawer. Proof-method fields switch instantly. No animation between evidence methods.
transitions.interaction: User-opened editor focuses heading. Invalid submit focuses correction summary linked to fields; wording matches inline errors. Preserve entered values and require explicit approvals.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Motion must not precheck approval, hide fields, expose private keys or turn an API outage into a field error.

transitions.name: Submit one reviewed case
transitions.trigger: Valid protected submit starts exactly one remember attempt.
transitions.meaning: The approval was submitted; durable completion is not yet known.
transitions.pacing: Show Submitting reviewed resolution immediately. Static wording is sufficient; optional CSS indicator opacity cycle 1000ms, never a progress percentage.
transitions.interaction: Keep focus; mark write status busy. Prevent duplicate submit through existing handler. Do not animate disabled controls or erase the draft until acceptance.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: A filling progress bar would invent completion; a repeated click must not write again.

transitions.name: Keep the accepted job visible
transitions.trigger: Remember response returns an accepted pending job ID.
transitions.meaning: Storage accepted the request; there is no completed blob yet.
transitions.pacing: Replace submission status at 0ms. Job ID appears in full with no typewriter effect. Static pending indicator; no ambient pulse.
transitions.interaction: Announce Storage accepted; completion pending once. Check status is a read of this job. Do not move focus on background status updates.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Pending cannot be a short interstitial that advances after a fixed time.

transitions.name: Acknowledge durable completion
transitions.trigger: Confirmed storage result includes the completed job receipt and Mainnet blob.
transitions.meaning: The reviewed case has a retained record. This says nothing about repairing the original chain transaction.
transitions.pacing: Receipt border/status may use one 160ms opacity reveal. Source/job/blob and next action are immediately readable. No pop, burst, bouncing check or count roll-up.
transitions.interaction: Announce Memory stored once. Keep receipt available across lookup/reload; background completion never steals focus.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Any delayed proof line or inferred success before job completion breaks the evidence claim.
transitions.implementation_source: remember() completed proof branch; checkStorage() receipt branch; retainStorage()

transitions.name: Recover without another write
transitions.trigger: Reload restores accepted job/receipt; explicit status read returns its actual state or fails.
transitions.meaning: An accepted operation can be recovered independently of a new incident lookup.
transitions.pacing: Restored information renders instantly. No replay of completion animation on hydration. Status-read failure leaves the accepted job and any prior receipt visible.
transitions.interaction: Keep focus on Check storage status; announce changed state once. No repeated assertive announcements on each poll.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Recovery must never silently call remember again or discard a durable receipt.
transitions.implementation_source: session storage initialization; checkStorage(); retainStorage(); failedStorageJob

transitions.name: Reuse on a distinct failure
transitions.end: reading → recalling → eligible / no-match / unavailable / error
transitions.trigger: User inspects a distinct recurrence, or protected exact-blob verification returns a result.
transitions.meaning: Retained engineering knowledge becomes useful for a compatible new failure.
transitions.pacing: Use M02–M05. Compare stable full blob text; no flying token, connector draw or automatic switch to a sample digest.
transitions.interaction: Receipt stays separate from query result. User chooses the next digest. Exact-recall success wording requires actual equality, never a visual resemblance.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Self-recall, incompatible case or service failure cannot earn the same success state. Failed recall does not invalidate completed storage.

transitions.name: Copy provenance
transitions.end: same state with local copy feedback
transitions.trigger: Clipboard promise resolves successfully following a user click.
transitions.meaning: The identifier was copied, not newly verified or saved.
transitions.pacing: Text feedback immediately; optional 100ms opacity. May clear feedback after 2 seconds, but must not change evidence or focus.
transitions.interaction: Keep button focus. Polite Copied announcement; failure shows selectable full identifier.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: A check icon could be misread as verification; avoid whole-panel animation.
transitions.implementation_source: Design Engineering enhancement only: clipboard handler not assumed present

transitions.name: Recover an unconfirmed submission
transitions.trigger: Transport failure loses the write response, explicit rejection returns, or status read reports terminal failure.
transitions.meaning: Unknown acceptance is different from accepted pending, known rejection and known failure.
transitions.pacing: Replace status immediately, 0ms. No countdown, automatic retry, progress bar or optimistic blob.
transitions.interaction: Unconfirmed response keeps the original attempt identity and permits existing-job recovery. Known rejection returns the editable review with visible reason; do not precheck approvals. Terminal failed job offers explicit dismissal; read failures preserve accepted job identity. Never infer acceptance without a job ID.
transitions.mobile: Same state order in one column. Preserve current reading position; no camera moves or automatic scroll.
transitions.reduced_motion: Instant state replacement; no translation, opacity tween, pulse, smooth scroll or rotating indicator. Keep all status text and announcements.
transitions.performance: Only opacity/transform if a transition is used; never animate height, width, blur or layout. No new animation library, decorative request or timer governing state.
transitions.risk: Retrying an ambiguous write could duplicate storage; calling a rejected or failed job pending would mislead the reviewer.
transitions.implementation_source: remember() catch RequestError status branch; storageAttempt without jobId; checkStorage() failedStorageJob; pending recovery panel

rules: Business state is driven only by real handler responses, never animation completion or elapsed time.
No scroll-driven evidence reveal or landing parallax.
All content remains accessible without animation; reduced motion is an immediate substitution.
No new writes or live services are used by this storyboard.
Repeated requests must retain existing race/duplicate protection; no new side effects belong in animation callbacks.
production_qa: Slow and instant transaction/recall responses do not show stale candidate evidence.
Protected review keeps both proof methods, all fields and explicit approval controls.
Pending job never displays a blob until actual completion.
Reload/status read recovers the same job and receipt without a new write.
Distinct matching recurrence preserves exact blob; self/mismatch/outage do not show verified reuse.
Keyboard focus and announcements are stable; provenance stays copyable.
Reduced motion removes all tween/loop/smooth-scroll including pseudo-elements.
1440×900,768px and390×844 retain reading order and no clipping.
Record actual product state sequences at Phase22; static storyboard QA cannot accept runtime motion.
